notes.title: Bow hunting coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25371350/6040d5973497017d26d4b95d262fb24b89d968c9.jpg[/img]

As we are now finalizing testing on the soon to be released 'Hunting Bow' (Keep an eye out for a release date real soon!) we are starting to work on the new 'Trail Cam'

You will be able to buy the Camera and choose to set it up at any hunting location as part of that Hunting Task.

Once placed you will get an option each day in your Diary to upload a picture from the Camera. Then you can scope out a desired hunting location for game, from the comfort of you cabin. 
Uploading the photo will use a little cabin battery however...

In the Hunting Map screen you will be able to check on the location of your Trail Cam, anytime you hunt again at that location you will get the chance to retrieve the camera to let you replace at another location.

Simples ! :)

Coming soon...

notes.title: Fantastic new release #2 for e-River Cabin Journal !
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25371350/af66b9e175532b4d075933465c3a2ea87281961e.jpg[/img]

- Small bug fixes

- New ability for new players to select player 'Roles' that come with small skills boosts and sometimes equipment on start up (players not choosing one of these and existing players get the new 'Tenderfoot' 100Pt bonus'

- All new in game 'Objectives', From Bridge building to mine digging (although one will be available to new players they are recommend for experienced and established players)

- New building option : 'Cabin Porch', a place to rest, provides an extra woodstore, safe from flooding and enabling new 'Star Gazing' task... 

- Graphical enhancements to the zoomed out cabin screen

- New 'Lingonberries' to collect and dry (to obtain 'Fruit leather') enabling you to now store berried for the winter

Enjoy!

NB: WJG intend in future, now that we have more stability, to make more frequent/smaller releases in future. Hopefully starting with introduction of the 'Hunting Bow', Followed by new 'Group Player' real time tasks, then narrative and story enhancements...

Calling all Cabin Owners....DO THIS TODAY !

Make sure you can carry on with your current game after tomorrows update just follow these simple steps BEFORE the 10th Dec...

1. Find and copy your save game, it's here:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\e-River Cabin Journal
(its a txt file called 'eCabinSaveGame')
2. Paste that file into your 'my documents' folder (In Windows 10 it's just called 'documents'
Do this on the 9th and when you get the new update on the 10th you can just continue and load your save game as normal*
*NB, In future you will have two save files and these will both be in your 'Documents' folder...

Hi everyone,
Our first big release is due to land on Saturday the 10th of December. As well as lots of cool new 'stuff' it will also mean that further updates wont wipe your save game progress BUT THIS UPDATE WILL!



So to make sure you can carry on with your current game just follow these simple steps.

1. Find and copy your save game, it's here:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\e-River Cabin Journal

(its a txt file called 'eCabinSaveGame')

2. Paste that file into your 'my documents' folder (In Windows 10 it's just called 'documents')

Do this on the 9th and when you get the new update on the 10th you can just continue and load your save game as normal*

*NB, In future you will have two save files and these will both be in your 'Documents' folder... :BearPaw:

notes.title: BACK UP YOUR SAVE GAME TODAY ! - UPDATE NOW COMING 8TH Aug
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Well the planned update for yesterday did not go well ! (I have explained my failings in detail on the discussion board thread 'Bug Reports and Tech Issues - Beware of Update' thanks to Shaa99 for reporting issues super quick and advice on how to locate save file quickly + potential workaround)

You will see that we had to revert the update AND that the update seems to wipe out existing Save games (!). Whilst we have fixed the errors that prevented the update working it looks like for now that any update WILL delete players existing Save games (it appears to be a common issue with some Steam Games)

Our sincere apologies for that mess up!, If it helps I am severely hating on myself for making such a hash of things (some issues were with Steam BUT more than 50% were my plain old ineptitude :(    ) 

So...MAKE A COPY OF YOUR SAVE GAME TODAY
The file is 'eCabinSaveGame' and the default location is 'C:ProgramFiles(86)/Steam/Steamapps/common/e-RiverCabinJournal 

To get to your saved game file quickly you can right click on the game title, select properties (bottom choice) than use the local files tab. The first choice then is to "browse local files". This Brings up the game folder.

WE WILL RELEASE THE UPDATE 6PM BST 8/8/16

notes.title: Feedback & Suggestions...
notes.content:
Hi everyone, firstly can we say THANKS, the feedback which has been fantastic and the comments in the reviews has been really helpful for us (Yes even the negative ones...in fact ESPECIALLY the negative ones. almost everyone has been pretty fair and reasonable with their opinions and suggestions. Criticism is how we will listen and improve. We know we will never please everyone but that's life...)

IF people accept the whole 'waiting thing' (even with speed ups) and if they are gracious enough to accommodate our limited coding experience then almost everyone seems to like the game premise. But there are barriers for some...

What we are hearing so far is - 

1) We struggle with the interface - we don't know what the buttons do...

OK, I was surprised at how much an issue this is for some, I suspect we were too familiar with the layout, also this is a new game style and we had nothing to go on. Either way we hear what people are saying and think we can address it (still limitations in how we meet the need but we are trying some things out - see video below. Not 100% but is this what people are after?) 



http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727109805


2) We prefer 'full screen'

Partly linked to high resolutions used by some but certainly not helped by the limited way we had to produce the game. No quick fix promised on this one, we tried a full screen test/image this evening and whilst it looks fine it produces memory issues so this will take more time. But again we will investigate further.

See image below BUT don't get too excited on this one as it will be a coding challenge that will take a while...


[IMG] http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727107627&fileuploadsuccess=1 [IMG]

3) I keep getting attacked by "Moose", "Bear"..."Insert vicious animal of your choice here"...

Looks to be down to just bad luck BUT we have an idea to balance better in that we will introduce a feature to look out for multiple attacks and influence the random code to make it less and less likely if you keep getting attacked in any one session.

NB. A future build on the stocks will add a 'Fence' to your cabin, once built this will let you chop wood and fell trees in relative safety (when you undertake the activity you will be able to choose to do it inside or outside your fence boundary). Of course you will need to fix breaches in the fence and as you fell trees within the fenced area they will become more and more scarce over time...
You will even be able to hook it up to the cabin battery and electrify it !

Let us know what you think of this idea


Some great ideas coming our way from players (such as the ability to demolish your cabin and re-locate for the winter/summer...). Keep em coming and thanks for both your support and encouragement.
